name: BIZcomfort Kyoto Shijo Karasuma
card: A 24-hour coworking space with Japanese-style interiors on Nishikikoji Street, 4 minutes from Shijo and Karasuma stations
title: BIZcomfort Kyoto Shijo Karasuma — Japanese-style coworking near Nishiki Market
lead: Four minutes' walk from Exit 22 of Shijo Station (Karasuma Subway Line) and Karasuma Station (Hankyu Line), BIZcomfort Kyoto Shijo Karasuma is on the 4th and 5th floors of the Ishikan Building on Nishikikoji Street in Nakagyo Ward. Members can use it 24 hours a day, every day, and on weekdays from 9:00 to 18:00 you can drop in without registering. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 4 min walk from Exit 22 of Shijo Station (Karasuma Line) and Karasuma Station (Hankyu Kyoto Line)
Members 24 hours, every day / drop-in weekdays 9:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00)
Drop-in ¥550 per hour, ¥1,650 per day / 1-minute plan ¥6.6 per minute (registration fee ¥5,500) / every-day plan ¥13,200/month
47 free-seating desks, 13 semi-private booths, 55 private offices
hero_cap: The lounge with round paper-style lamps
concept: BIZcomfort describes Shijo Karasuma as an attractive area where tradition and the modern city blend together.
The interior uses wooden pillars, noren curtains and round paper-style lamps. Drinks, printers and lockers are available, and there are meeting rooms and online-meeting rooms.
steps: A lounge with round lamps and wooden pillars.
The lounge with round paper-style lamps
In the work booths, food and online meetings are not allowed and calls are limited to 10 minutes.
There are 13 semi-private booths for semi-private plan members.
Café booths allow food, calls and online meetings.

word.title: What is a drop-in?
body: Using the space for just one day without becoming a member.
At BIZcomfort Kyoto Shijo Karasuma you can drop in on weekdays from 9:00 to 18:00 for ¥550 per hour or ¥1,650 per day. Reservations are not taken.

credits: BIZcomfort official website: “BIZcomfort Kyoto Shijo Karasuma”

name: BIZcomfort Sapporo Susukino
card: A 24-hour coworking space with a plant-filled lounge, 1 minute from Hosui-Susukino Station
title: BIZcomfort Sapporo Susukino — 24-hour coworking 1 minute from Hosui-Susukino Station
lead: One minute's walk from Exit 1 of Hosui-Susukino Station on the Toho Subway Line, BIZcomfort Sapporo Susukino is on the 4th floor of NBF CONNECT SAPPORO in Chuo Ward. It is BIZcomfort's second location in Sapporo. Members can use it 24 hours a day, every day, and on weekdays from 9:00 to 18:00 you can drop in without registering. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 1 min walk from Exit 1 of Hosui-Susukino Station (Toho Line) / 4 min from Exit 35 of Odori Station / 5 min from Exit 1 of Susukino Station (Namboku Line)
Members 24 hours, every day / drop-in weekdays 9:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00)
Drop-in from ¥550 per hour / 1-minute plan ¥8.8 per minute (registration fee ¥5,500) / every-day plan ¥17,600/month
70 free-seating desks, 11 semi-private booths, 45 private offices
hero_cap: Cross Lounge, at the centre of the floor
concept: BIZcomfort says Cross Lounge, at the centre of the space, is the hub for meeting people and moving around the office.
The floor is zoned by purpose, so you can use it for remote work, meetings or quiet study. There is a staffed reception and meeting rooms.
steps: A central lounge surrounded by plants.
Cross Lounge, at the centre of the floor
The lounge with a large mural
There are counter seats facing the windows.
Café booths allow food, calls and online meetings.
Meeting rooms are paid and must be booked.
A meeting room with a mountain mural

word.title: What is the Hokkaido plan?
body: A monthly plan for using BIZcomfort and partner coworking spaces across Hokkaido at any time.
The price list at BIZcomfort Sapporo Susukino shows ¥18,700 a month.
